data.name: Chanchareek
data.gender_notes: Chanchareek is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Goddess of prosperity and good fortune
data.long_meaning: The name Chanchareek is derived from the Sanskrit language and is believed to be the name of a goddess who symbolizes prosperity and good fortune. She is often invoked for her blessings of wealth, happiness, and success in life. The name Chanchareek carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity and good fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chanchareek usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Invokes blessings of prosperity and good fortune
data.etymology: Chanchareek belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity and good fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chanchareek total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It is often found in names of influential figures, indicating their connection to the goddess of the same name and invoking her blessings for their endeavors.

It is often seen as a reminder to seek the blessings of the goddess and trust in her power to guide and bring prosperity to one's life.
